# Hiroshima Travel and Tours

> > Guided tours and cultural experiences in Hiroshima, Japan, featuring atomic bomb history, sea kayaking to Studio Ghibli film locations, traditional Japanese arts, and Miyajima World Heritage Site visits.

Hiroshima Travel and Tours specializes in authentic experiences across Hiroshima Prefecture, from peace history bike tours and Seto Inland Sea kayaking adventures to traditional Noh theater, tea ceremonies, and kimono experiences. Tours explore iconic locations including Miyajima's Itsukushima Shrine, Tomonoura's Studio Ghibli settings, and atomic bomb memorial sites.

## Key Topics

- Hiroshima atomic bomb sites and peace history
- Miyajima and Itsukushima Shrine World Heritage Site
- Tomonoura and Studio Ghibli film locations (Ponyo)
- Seto Inland Sea kayaking and island tours
- Traditional Japanese tea ceremony
- Kimono rental and cultural experiences
- Noh theater performances in Fukuyama
- Guided bicycle tours
- Calligraphy and traditional arts
- Hiroshima oyster dining experiences
- Hatsukaichi cultural activities
- Heian period aristocrat costumes
- Koto traditional music instruction
- Abuto Kannon temple visits

## Tours and Activities Overview

- [Hiroshima Tours - Hiroshima Travel and Tours](https://hiroshimatravelandtours.com/hiroshima-tours): Hiroshima cultural tours: Noh theater, tea ceremony, kimono, and Miyajima
- [Hiroshima Food and Experiences - Hiroshima Travel and Tours](https://hiroshimatravelandtours.com/hiroshima-food-and-experiences): Cultural activities in Hiroshima: kimono, calligraphy, cooking, and oysters
- [Hiroshima Water (Kayaking) - Hiroshima Travel and Tours](https://hiroshimatravelandtours.com/hiroshima-water-kayaking): Sea kayaking tours in Hiroshima including Tomonoura and Setouchi Islands
- [Hiroshima Wheeling (Bicycling) - Hiroshima Travel and Tours](https://hiroshimatravelandtours.com/hiroshima-wheeling-bicycling): Guided bike tours exploring Hiroshima's atomic bomb sites and peace history

## Sea Kayaking Adventures

- [Hiroshima Kayaking Day Trip to Famous Anime and Ghibli Film Sets by Sea Tour](https://hiroshimatravelandtours.com/hiroshima-water-kayaking/hiroshima-day-kayaking-tour-in-the-sea-to-studio-ghibli-and-hollywood-settings): Full-day kayak tour to Tomonoura's Studio Ghibli film locations in Seto Sea
- [Hiroshima Kayaking Half Day Trip to Famous Anime and Ghibli Film Sets by Sea Tour](https://hiroshimatravelandtours.com/hiroshima-water-kayaking/hiroshima-half-day-sea-kayaking-tour-to-studio-ghibli-and-hollywood-settings): Half-day kayak tour to Tomonoura's Studio Ghibli filming locations
- [Hiroshima Setouchi Islands Kayak Day Tour with Lunch](https://hiroshimatravelandtours.com/hiroshima-water-kayaking/hiroshima-setouchi-islands-full-day-kayak-tour-with-lunch): Full-day Setouchi Islands kayak tour visiting Tomonoura and Benten Island

## Atomic Bomb History and Peace Tours

- [Tour Hiroshima by Bicycle with a guide Born and Raised in Hiroshima - See Damage](https://hiroshimatravelandtours.com/hiroshima-wheeling-bicycling/bike-tour-of-atomic-bomb-and-history-sites-in-hiroshima-with-a-guide-born-there): Electric bike tour of atomic bomb sites with local Hiroshima-born guide
